reader.requirement: At --std 85, every SUBTRACT format carries enough digits in its temporary sum and result that no significant digit is lost before the final store: a sum of several 18-digit operands that needs 19 or more digits, mixed scales up to the 18-digit composite, P-scaled operands, and rounding decided on the exact result.
reader.edition-search: grep of DialectLevel|MaxDigits|Edition.Year|DialectBehaviors over NumericRenderer.cs: no edition switch (the carrier is chosen by digit bounds, WideMaxDigits, at every edition). The only edition switches on the SUBTRACT path are EmitArith's size-error arm and CheckComposite's cap, neither of which changes the carried precision.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f14_03 covers a decimal intermediate; not exercised: 19-digit temporary sums of 18-digit operands, COMP/COMP-3 18-digit operands, rounding that depends on the ninth fraction digit, P scaling.

probes.expected: exact 18-digit mixed-scale result; K1+K2+K3 (19-digit partial sum) cancels exactly; 19-digit results detected as size errors with the receiver unchanged; smallest fraction kept
1-0.500000001=0.499999999 ROUNDED 0; 1-0.499999999=0.500000001 ROUNDED 1 (rounding on the exact result)
two 18-digit literals summed to 19 digits exactly; PIC 9PP 500 minus VPP9 .003 = 499.997, truncated 400, ROUNDED 500

reader.notes: The renderer folds in Int128 or the wide exact carrier by digit bounds, so 19-digit temporaries and mixed scales stay exact; every probe result is the exact arithmetic value before the receiver's truncation or rounding.

refuter.evidence: Probes at --std 85 (rsub1-001) aimed at a carrier that would wrap: 20 x S9(18) COMP 999999999999999999 (sum 1.99999e19, beyond Int64 and beyond 2^64 modulo would fit 18 digits) FROM 0 -> SIZE, receiver unchanged +0 (S11); same into GIVING COMP-3 -> SIZE (S12); FROM -999999999999999999 -> SIZE, unchanged (S13); 20 x S9(18) COMP-3 -> SIZE (S14). No significant digit lost in the temporary. The 18-digit operand cap (COBOL0802) and composite cap (COBOL0805) are refused at 85, so no larger form reaches the rule. cite.py: OK §1985:VI.6.26.4 GR4.
